t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndi ni lirola, Oh Nyasaye wanje, shijira Wanomba Khukhumanya nuk-khusaala Yiwe. Ndolekhitsanya, khu inyinga yinu, vudedekhere vwanje nu khutsingulu Tsiotsio, khuvudakha vwanje na khuvuruji Vwovwo. Shaliho Nyasaye wundi na akhali Yiwe, Mukhonyi mu shivi, na Umenyanga Wonyene.
